name: ibm-quantum
description: Quantum programs with Qiskit through the IBM Quantum connector, which already runs Qiskit, its exact and Aer simulators and IBM's fake devices on this machine, with nothing to install: build and simulate circuits (exactly, with ideal shots, or with a real device's noise), keep every run as a job, compare backends, see circuits, layouts, results and devices in views the person can work in, train hybrid quantum-classical models, and use real hardware only on purpose and within the time left. It belongs to the IBM Quantum connector: add it to a conversation while that connector is enabled.
